how to become the best student
in your year

before term starts

one notebook per subject.
a calendar with every deadline already in it.

every class

sit near the front.
write down the questions, not just the answers.

every week

review every subject once,
even the ones with no test coming.

before exams

before, i only studied the night before.
now i learn one new thing every morning. and i understand the big picture before i revise.
